candidate.title: Chem-Seq
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina Chem-seq schematic, covering its explicitly labeled in vivo (upper) and in vitro (lower) versions through separate purified-DNA endpoints. The leftmost bound-site image states the assay aim, while the neighboring DNA-protein complex is the starting target context. These are two versions of Chem-seq, not additional assays. The primary Anders JQ1 implementation resolves fixation history, the extract interface and lower-route ligand immobilization; these refinements do not assert that every Chem-seq implementation uses identical preparation. The diagram ends at DNA: downstream library construction, sequencing and genomic interpretation are explained only to identify the readout carrier, without adding unshown library-preparation operations.
